title: Longest Common Substring
statement:
Given two strings A and B, find the length of their longest common substring.

A substring is a contiguous sequence of characters. The common substring must appear as a contiguous block in both A and B.
inputFormat: Two lines: the first contains A, the second contains B.
outputFormat: A single integer: the length of the longest common substring.
constraints:
1 <= |A|, |B| <= 1000
A and B contain only lowercase English letters.

examples.explanation: No common characters in contiguous sequence.

starterCode.python:
a = input().strip()
b = input().strip()
# Write your solution here
# Hint: use DP table dp[i][j] = length of common suffix ending at a[i-1] and b[j-1]
